flashcard_questions.q: The single overall force acting on an object when all individual forces are combined.
A state where all forces acting on an object are balanced, so there is no change in motion.
The tendency of an object to resist a change in its state of motion; it depends on the object's mass.

flashcard_questions.a: A measure of how difficult it is to change the velocity of an object, equal to the ratio of force to acceleration (m = F ÷ a).
The force of gravity per unit mass at a point in a gravitational field, measured in N/kg. On Earth, g is approximately 9.8 N/kg.
